correctness.rationale: Exact original acyclic Morse certificate proves covering simple connectivity; all 48 automorphisms and all 4670 quotient flags are generated; orbit chains have integer d^2=0, exact unit cancellations 1021+1313 leave C0=C4=Z and no torsion. Three point-fixing generators normally generate the entire group, proving quotient simple connectivity under Armstrong; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead imply S4.

originality.rationale: Exact-object full prior published results prove only the unquotiented M_2(K_{2,2,2}) wedge homotopy, and do not determine the ordinary orbit space by the full 48-element group. New integral quotient boundaries and normal-generation simple connectivity do not follow from the prior statements. Remaining risk is inaccessible historical material or unindexed equivalent work.
residual_risks: The complete historical Jonsson book was not accessible; only publisher preview read.

value.rationale: The octahedral graph is the smallest balanced complete tripartite graph, and the degree-two bounded-degree complex and full 48-element automorphism quotient are canonical. Previously published mixed-dimensional sphere wedges for the unquotiented space do not supply the integral topology of the orbit space. The new integral sphere homotopy classification excludes both potential torsion and fundamental-group obstructions, a mathematically motivated endpoint for this natural graph object.
